description: Game context for Cramped Room layout - a small kitchen with limited space and one pot
game_context:
# OVERCOOKED GAME BACKGROUND - CRAMPED ROOM



  Game Context:
- The Overcooked_AI game requires two players to work together as a team with the goal of achieving the highest possible score.
- To get the points, the team need to make soup according to recipe, fill the soup in a dish and immediately deliver the soup. Once a delivery is made, the team gets 20 points. Plus, this soup and dishes will disappear, no need to wash and recycle the dishes.
- recipe: THREE onions in the <Pot>
- To make a soup, the team must pick up THREE onions one by one, put them in a <Pot>. <Pot> will automatically start cooking when <Pot> is full (contains 3 onions) and it will take 20 time steps to complete the soup.
- Each player can only pick up and hold one item at a time.To put down the thing which player is holding and empty his hand, he should use place_obj_on_counter().
- <Pot> can hold THREE ingredients.
- After start cooking, <Pot> needs 20 cooking timesteps to finish a food. Before the food is finished, players should:
        - If all pots are cooking or ready, Pick up a dish and then fill dish with soup.
        - If there is a pot not full in the environment, Prepare for another cook cycle.
- <Player 1> and <Player 0> cannot communicate and always take actions at the same time.
- <Pot> is full when it contains 3 onions.
- For each step, you will receive the current scene (including the kitchen, teammates status).


Legal actions for each player:
In this game, each player can ONLY perform the following 6 allowed skill: pickup_onion_from_dispenser, pickup_onion_from_counter, pickup(dish), place_obj_on_counter(), put_onion_in_pot(), fill_dish_with_soup(), deliver_soup(), wait(x). Do not attempt to use any other skills that are not listed here.
    - pickup_onion_from_dispenser
        - Player needs to have nothing in hand.
        - Pick up onion directly from the onion dispenser.
    - pickup_onion_from_counter
        - Player needs to have nothing in hand.
        - There must be an onion on the counter.
        - Pick up onion from the counter.
    - put_onion_in_pot()
        - I need to have an onion in hand.
    - pickup(dish)
        - I need to have nothing in hand.
        - A player can hold only one dish at a time.
    - fill_dish_with_soup()
        - I need to have a dish in hand.
    - deliver_soup()
        - I need to have soup in hand.
        - The dish and soup will both disappear.
    - place_obj_on_counter()
        - I need to have something in hand.
    - wait(x) 
        - wait for x timestep and do nothing. 

- Map description: The kitchen features a large open central area with a single pot placed at the top center. Onion supply crates are positioned on both the left and right sides of the map, while dishes are located at the bottom left and the delivery area is at the bottom center.

Initial State(X are counters, P are pots, O are onion dispensers, D are dish dispensers, S is serving station): 
X       X       P       X       X       

O                       ↑1      O       

X       ↑0                      X       

X       D       X       S       X       

Here's the layout of the kitchen: <Onion Dispenser 0>, <Onion Dispenser 1>, <Dish Dispenser 0>, <Serving Loc 0>, <Pot 0>.
